The new --pin-unique-commits is silently ignored under --scratch: the scratch branch calls garbage_collect_scratch (reckon/cli.py:5558-5562) which takes no pin argument, so 'crew gc --scratch --pin-unique-commits' reports the scratch sweep with the flag having no effect. This extends an existing pattern — the scratch branch already ignores --integrated-into and --retention-days — and pinning a scratch directory is meaningless, so it does not hold the node; the flag's help ('releases a dirty worktree') is the place a one-clause caveat would remove the surprise.
